description: OpenThrottle dependency-license policy. Allowlist-based: a package passes only if every license in its SPDX expression is in `allow`, OR the package is covered by an `exceptions` waiver. Anything else — copyleft (AGPL/GPL/LGPL/SSPL/BUSL), 'Commercial'/proprietary, or an undetected 'Unknown' — fails the CI gate. Consumed by scripts/validate-license-compliance.ts. Seeded from docs/monorepo/dependency-license-audit.md (plan 956e3522). See CONTRIBUTING.md § Dependency licenses for the waiver process. Keep arrays sorted.

exceptions.reason: Nx Powerpack (paid, proprietary) remote-cache add-on. Build-time only, never shipped in any product bundle. Migration off it is tracked separately in plan aec1b0b2-2ee9-4aa1-9229-1e1bee4191f2 (also clears CVE-2025-36852); waived here so the gate is green until that lands.

Nx Powerpack license-activation helper, transitive via @nx/gcs-cache. Build-time only, never shipped. See plan aec1b0b2-2ee9-4aa1-9229-1e1bee4191f2. Its per-arch native binaries (@nx/key-<os>-<arch>) need no separate waiver: they declare os/cpu and are excluded from the gate as platform-specific.

Source-available non-compete (PolyForm Shield 1.0.0). Competing use is scoped to paper.design's design-tooling domain, not OpenThrottle's task-runner/platform domain. Owner-approved waiver 2026-07-27; see docs/monorepo/dependency-license-audit.md. Requires NOTICE attribution.
